coverage: 2000-present: the Governor's newsroom releases and executive orders, plus states of emergency added by hand: 2000-2007 ones (Governors Patton and Fletcher) from Appendix A of Beshear v. Acree (Ky. 2020), which lists every declaration of emergency filed in the Executive Journal by filing date and order number, and 2008-2024 ones from executive orders, official releases and dated news coverage; the Secretary of State's Executive Journal (authoritative) blocks automated requests, so four 2008-2011 declarations of emergency (April 2008, May and August 2009, June 2011) were read from it by hand and are dated by their filing dates; a search of its Declarations of Emergency finds none filed in 2014 or between August 8 and October 1, 2024, so no state declaration is listed for the August 2014 storms or Helene in 2024 (DR-4196, DR-4848)
